QUOTE: #ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member #else #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member #endif — plus "External consumers get the renamed fields... The library itself needs the real names. It opts out with `#define MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows both macro branches and explains that code defining the opt-out sees real names while ordinary public-header consumers see the `private_`-prefixed names.
